notes.title: It's time to start jumping!
notes.notes:
After a long year of development and many changes, Enduring Dreamers™: Freya is finally out!

How far can you get on slippery ice?

And if that wasn't enough, you also have to deal with many different obstacles, including a relentless storm that will never stop chasing you!

So grab your favorite boots and start jumping and crushing your friend's highscores.
